info.title: Nihon API
info.description:
REST contract of the local Nihon server. Generated from the server's operation declarations; do not edit.

Generated clients send `Nihon-API-Version: 1`. The server refuses a different major version with `400 unsupported_api_version`; `GET /api/health` stays available to every client and reports `apiVersion`. Every response carries `Nihon-Request-Id`, also present in error bodies. Conventions: docs/architecture/api-contract.md.

apiVersion.description: Contract version the server implements; clients compare its major part.

code.description: Stable, snake_case error code. Clients branch on it, never on the message.

message.description: English explanation for developers; not meant for display.

requestId.description: Correlates the response with the server log.

path.description: Location of the invalid input, such as `query.limit`.

issues.description: Present on `validation_failed`: one entry per invalid input.

id.description: Opaque identifier of 1 to 64 characters `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -`.

username.description: Display form of the username, NFKC-normalized, case preserved.

role.description: Permission role. Every new account is `user`; the role cannot be chosen at registration.

registeredWith.description: How the profile was created: `local` for a username and password, otherwise the provider identifier.

Profile.description: A local Nihon profile. It carries no credential and no provider data.

username.description: Account name, 3 to 32 characters after Unicode NFKC normalization: letters of any script, digits, `_`, `-`, `.`, starting with a letter or digit. Two names that normalize to the same lowercase form are the same name.

password.description: Local password, 8 to 128 characters after Unicode NFKC normalization, no control characters, different from the username. Hashed with Argon2id; never stored or returned as given.

LocalRegistration.description: Credentials of a new local account. Fields other than these two, such as `role`, are refused.

id.description: Provider identifier as listed by `listOAuthProviders`, such as `google` or `github`.

items.description: Providers this installation is configured for; empty when it has none or is offline.

authorizationUrl.description: Address to open in the browser to authenticate with the provider.

state.description: Value the provider returns to `redirectUri`. The client compares it with the returned one, then sends it to `completeOAuthRegistration`.

expiresAt.description: The flow can be completed until this instant.

OAuthRegistrationStarted.description: A provider registration waiting for the browser to return.

provider.description: Provider identifier as listed by `listOAuthProviders`, such as `google` or `github`.

username.description: Account name, 3 to 32 characters after Unicode NFKC normalization: letters of any script, digits, `_`, `-`, `.`, starting with a letter or digit. Two names that normalize to the same lowercase form are the same name.

redirectUri.description: Where the browser returns after the provider: an `http://127.0.0.1`, `http://localhost`, or `http://[::1]` address, or an address the installation lists in `NIHON_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URIS`. Must also be registered with the provider.

OAuthRegistrationStart.description: Starts a provider registration for a chosen username.

state.description: `state` of the flow, as returned by the provider.

code.description: Authorization code the provider returned to `redirectUri`.

OAuthRegistrationCompletion.description: The provider answer for a started registration. A flow can be completed once.

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).

post.summary: Register a local account with a username and password
post.description: Works offline. Creates the profile and its credential together or not at all. No session is opened.

400.description: Refused request: invalid input (`validation_failed`) or incompatible client (`unsupported_api_version`).

409.description: The normalized username is already used (`accounts_username_taken`).

503.description: Too many registrations are being processed; retry after `Retry-After` (`accounts_busy`).

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).

get.summary: List the providers available for registration

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).

post.summary: Start registering with a Google or GitHub identity
post.description: Requires Internet to reach the provider. The username is checked now and again when the flow completes. The flow expires after 10 minutes.

400.description: Refused request: invalid input (`validation_failed`) or incompatible client (`unsupported_api_version`). `redirectUri` is not an accepted return address (`accounts_oauth_redirect_uri_invalid`).

409.description: The normalized username is already used (`accounts_username_taken`).

422.description: The provider is unknown or not configured on this installation (`accounts_oauth_provider_unavailable`).

503.description: Too many provider flows are pending; retry after `Retry-After` (`accounts_busy`).

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).

post.summary: Complete a provider registration with the returned code
post.description: Verifies the code and identity with the provider, then creates the profile and its provider link together or not at all. The flow is consumed on the first attempt, successful or not: a replayed or concurrent completion creates nothing. An email address is neither required nor read, and profiles are never merged by email.

201.description: The profile and its provider link were created.

400.description: Refused request: invalid input (`validation_failed`) or incompatible client (`unsupported_api_version`). The flow is unknown or already used (`accounts_oauth_state_invalid`), expired (`accounts_oauth_state_expired`), the provider refused the code (`accounts_oauth_code_rejected`), or the identity could not be verified (`accounts_oauth_identity_unverified`).

409.description: The username was taken meanwhile (`accounts_username_taken`), or this provider identity already has a profile (`accounts_identity_already_registered`).

422.description: The flow was started for a provider this installation no longer has configured (`accounts_oauth_provider_unavailable`); the flow is consumed.

502.description: The provider could not be reached or answered unusably (`accounts_oauth_provider_failed`); the flow is consumed, start a new registration.

503.description: Too many provider exchanges are running (`accounts_busy`, `Retry-After` set): the flow is untouched, retry the same completion. If instead the database stayed busy after the provider answered (`accounts_oauth_flow_consumed`, no `Retry-After`), nothing was created and the flow is used up: start a new registration.

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).
